content.what_it_is: Third-party MATLAB utility (Pekka Kumpulainen, Tampere University of Technology, 21.5.2012; L25-L26) bundled with the single_vessel_cohesive case; byte-identical (same source SHA-256) to multi_vessel_morphology/tight_subplot.m. Creates subplot axes with adjustable gaps and margins: signature [ha, pos] = tight_subplot(Nh, Nw, gap, marg_h, marg_w) (L1), documented inputs/outputs and example (L3-L23). Defaults gap=.02, marg_h=.05, marg_w=.05 (L29-L31); scalar arguments expanded to pairs (L33-L41). Axis size formulas axh=(1-sum(marg_h)-(Nh-1)*gap(1))/Nh and axw=(1-sum(marg_w)-(Nw-1)*gap(2))/Nw (L43-L44). Starting at py=1-marg_h(2)-axh (L46), nested loops (L50-L62) create normalized axes at [px py axw axh] with blanked tick labels (L55-L58), advancing px by axw+gap(2) (L59) and py downward by axh+gap(1) (L61). pos returned only when requested (L63-L65); ha reshaped to column (L66).
entities: ha output axes handle array L1, filled L55, reshaped L66
pos output positions L1, set L64
